name: tg-property-tax
description: Prepare a Togo annual property-tax working paper for 2026 from the read CGI and LPF, with the enacted finance-law valuation overlay. Use this Guide for built and unbuilt property, liable property-right holders, cadastral valuation, the commercial balance-sheet asset rule, permanent and temporary exemptions, instalments and evidence for relief. It separates annual ownership tax from rental income tax, rental withholding and transfer duties. Two executable cases recompute a commercial property assessment and the different temporary-exemption windows for commercial and residential construction. Current cadastral forms, live payment references, special restructuring approvals and later-law continuity remain explicit holds. Trigger phrases include Togo taxe foncière, property assessment, cadastral rental value and new-building exemption.
